lesson: The tip-in forecast concentrated on centers and rebounding specialists and omitted a high-minute wing who cuts and crashes the glass. Event-specific scorer pools still need every high-minute player with a plausible route to the play, not only the positional archetype most associated with it.

El-Obeid was included but underweighted despite the most recent direct reporting about partial encirclement and urban risk. Current, location-specific operational evidence should outweigh a more speculative match to the wording about the attacking coalition.

The diplomatic-death forecast anchored on nearby Asian missions and omitted the United States. For vague overseas diplomatic incidents, candidate generation should include globally large missions and major powers even when the location encourages a regional shortlist.

The Portugal-friendly forecast covered central stars but omitted a selected winger who had a realistic rotation role. Friendly-match scorer pools require a full scan of the current forward roster, with extra weight on wingers and substitutes likely to receive substantial minutes.

The slate reused familiar historical Canadian bill labels and missed the bill number in the current parliamentary neighborhood. Legislative forecasts should first map the live session's bill-number range and active docket before applying topical analogies from earlier parliaments.
